Data integrity & methodology

Source: Practical assignment.xlsx. Workbook guidance defines the analysis; this web dashboard follows your requested format.

Metric definitions and limitations
  • Names are matched by lowercase letters/digits after removing parenthesized role suffixes. No speculative fuzzy matches. Duplicate roster names retain the first record and are reported below.
  • Level 1 = beginner, Level 2 = intermediate, Level 3 = expert, as specified in Read Me. The workbook point score runs in the opposite direction; it is not used as a proficiency index.
  • FTFR rates are identical across all five technologies in the source. No visit denominators or monthly dates are available. It is shown as a snapshot engineer mean, unchanged by month filters. Technology comparisons reuse these source rates and cannot establish technology-specific FTFR differences.
  • Resolution days use the supplied nonnegative Days to Resolve, not elapsed business hours. OTD is Hit / (Hit + Miss) only; records with other flags are excluded from its denominator. Resolution deduplication key: work order, line item and service appointment.
  • Escalations count distinct case + work order + line item + appointment combinations by dispatched month. Escalation case rates are unavailable because sources do not define a matching service population. No escalation rate is fabricated.
  • Service month uses Created Date; escalation month uses Dispatched Time. Roster and assessment values are snapshots, so certification history and monthly causal effects are unavailable.
  • North, North1 and North2 remain separate source zones. LASER SOLID STATE, LPA and GRAPHICS BA remain separate product families; unassessed families cannot be assigned a certification level.
  • Financial ROI and revenue growth are unavailable: no training cost, revenue, margin, or certification intervention history was supplied. Illustrative targets and previous-month values in Dashboard Example are not treated as actuals.
  • Installed-base coverage = installed units assigned to engineers with a recorded Level 1–3 assessment / all installed units in scope. This measures assessed coverage, not guaranteed service capacity.
